data.one_liner: Infobip Mobile Messaging Flutter Plugin for push notifications, LiveChat, and WebRTC calls.
data.what_it_does: Enables push notifications, LiveChat, and WebRTC calls in Flutter apps via the Infobip Mobile Messaging platform. Handles SDK initialization, message event listeners, and platform-specific configurations.
use_when: You need to integrate Infobip push notifications in your Flutter app.
You want to use Infobip LiveChat and WebRTC calls.
You are targeting Android and iOS with native push integration.
avoid_when: You prefer an open-source self-hosted notification solution without third-party platform dependencies.
You only need local notifications without remote push capabilities.
strengths: Supports push notifications, LiveChat, and WebRTC calls out of the box.
Provides support for both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager on iOS.
Active updates matching native Android and iOS SDK versions.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configurations for iOS (AppDelegate, notification service extensions) and Android (Firebase setup, Google services).
Tied strictly to the proprietary Infobip backend and platform ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up an application at the Infobip portal, modifying iOS AppDelegate with delegate installation, configuring CocoaPods or SPM, and adding Firebase google-services for Android.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want direct Firebase Cloud Messaging integration without relying on the Infobip platform.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer OneSignal as an alternative push notification platform.

alternatives.name: intercom_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want an alternative all-in-one messaging and live chat platform.
